scope: Read-only final two-line production delta and related fixtures. No product module imports, tests, services, new raw scans or recordings were executed.
supersession: The prior review did not sufficiently cover initial no-witness selection liveness. This immutable addendum records that omission and reviews its correction without changing the prior artifact.

findingAndCorrection.initialIssue: A newly added adjacent-target/no-witness early return prevented original movement, remaining target and scout fallback; repeated native opportunities could stay in evidence-wait without any actual movement.
findingAndCorrection.finalInitialSelection: The premature return is removed. An unwitnessed target cannot enter the attack branch, but retains the original bounded adjacent-destination A* navigation, remaining candidate loop and scout/return fallback.
findingAndCorrection.preparedAttack: The separate send-time actual witness recheck remains. A prepared attack that loses its final witness sends nothing and records an incomplete evidence-wait native opportunity.
findingAndCorrection.measurement: Only a real successful authoritative UserLocation from the fallback Walk/Run can credit movement/native completion. Merely choosing or sending a plan adds no success. No attack, hit or combat-coverage requirement is fabricated.
findingAndCorrection.unchanged: Original activity cadence, 18 launches/12 positive hits, native completion, 4000-node search, route/transfer checks, dual-end damage, 900ms receipt window, quarantine, HP and poststrike changes are untouched by this delta.

checks: Five initial missing-object/dead/map/not-ready variants now assert actual movement selection rather than a fabricated unavailable attack.
